texts: Added a zoom mode option to the map viewer in GMS Explorer and the roadmap in the Timers and Roadmap page. You can swap between scroll (scroll to zoom) and click mode (left to zoom in, right to zoom out).
Adjusted the layout of the GMS Explorer page. The tabs are now found above the map rather than below to make them harder to miss.
Extended the intro of the Community Trivia page to mention the Submit tab.
Extended the tooltip on site search to explain how to use actions a bit more.
Added a border around the site search button to make it stand out a bit more.
Added the more recently added pages to the Manager's Guide.
Added a check to prevent players from accidentally submitting empty answers in the Community Trivia Quiz.
